title: Good Concept, great elements…but misses the sense of urgency
body:
Hello!

I’ve been on and off Habitica for the past years and I must say that the idea and the message that the app is trying to convey is fantastic: being able to make of habits a game where you can level up and show off gear, collectibles and many, many more!

However…I feel like things are missing. Sure, the app is easy to BEGIN to use, but not rewarding enough to KEEP using it. I don’t know, I just don’t find myself coming back to Habitica week in and week out, excited as to what else there is to do. Sometimes I feel the options and features from the habit forming itself are…kind off generic.

Checklists, some pre-set coins, experience that you cannot control, that sort of stuff that is just not customizable enough. Which makes me not be able to really make my OWN economy and see how much everything REALLY costs to ME. 

A good attempt at fostering community comes in the form of challenges, however I find them to be quite hard to follow due to their lackluster appearance. Like seriously, read 30min per day? Instead of some sort of buildup? Or maybe even group challenges competing against one other to not only have a community, but a competitive edge?

All these ideas including the features, the adaptability of the app and making a proactive community are a great start. Just really want this app to flourish and become the thing I expect it to be in the process of living out my life to my fullest potential. If you’re reading this, Thanks for reading this far and I hope you have a blessed life!🙌
author: Marco_270
